received_works.body:
Hi !! Your art is super cute as always and I would like to make another request !

I would like to commission an illustration of my VTuber. She is a magical girl with starry eyes and blonde highlights on her side bangs and tips of hair. Her outfit is themed around wishes and hope, with shooting stars and wings as a common theme. A star hangs off the wing to the right.

Can you draw her dressed up as Io, from Granblue Fantasy? Optionally, if you could include her weapon, that would be great! I would like for her to have a witty and cute pose/expression.

Io Reference: https://imgur.com/a/DQFSDAm

Character: See reference
Height: 160cm
Bust: B cup

I would like to use this around Twitter, Youtube, and Discord. Can you send a PSD with the image, signature, and background separated?

Thank you for your consideration!!

https://i.imgur.com/soG1G8j.jpeg

Hello! Your art style is so cute and soft I love it! The pose and outfit is up to you! Here is my reference: https://imgur.com/a/small-remi-2d-model-reference-twitch-tv-remi-remivespertine-carrd-co-OoaEVto

Thankyou!
